why: `depth` narrowed to the `uint8_t` the C ABI and the backend handle tables carry, saturating at 255. rclrs keeps one `u32` because rcl takes a `size_t`; ours needs the narrowed read because the value crosses a `repr(C)` boundary into a fixed-width field. The doc comment says "for backwards compatibility", which is not a reason -- worth a look in W5.
